name: square_confirmation
written: 2026-11-20, before any script was written or any outcome computed for this purpose
operator: 11/20: 'The stack replacement could identify earlier openings, maybe our current openings could support if the opening is working' -> two-stage design (early starter on an armed name, add on the desk's %R square confirmation, cut if none) -> 'How can we address some of these things that can sink our concept beforehand' -> 'Yes, pre-register the confirmation test'
question: After an early starter entry on an ARMED name, does the desk's %R square appearing within 15 minutes mark the starters whose run continues - i.e. is the return AFTER confirmation (the 'add') positive and better than what happens after an unconfirmed starter at its cut time?
prior_work_disclosed: the square as an ENTRY: square arms showed no runway vs random minutes (9/29), opening square FAIL (11/19, -10.7 bp), stack_search T4 (%R cross) no edge. The 10/24 lag audit measured the desk's arm ~14 min and ~24 bp after the %R turn. The square as CONFIRMATION of an earlier entry on an already-armed name has never been measured (operator 11/20: odds on the test's own merit).
events (the ARM): the trending_two_step / multisource_stack event set: first st_new per name-day on weekdays 09:35-15:00 ET, 2026-08-03..2026-11-19, monitor-down days dropped, price at entry >= $2 (PRIMARY; >= $20 as a sub-line)
STARTER: the first 1-minute bar t_s in [event minute, event minute + 30] whose close is above the high of the 5 bars before it (a 5-minute breakout); buy the OPEN of t_s + 1. No breakout in 30 minutes = no starter (counted).
CONFIRMATION: the desk's square (opening_square.square_bars: fast %R (21, EWM 7) and slow %R (112, EWM 3) both >= -20 on the bar and not on the bar before, fast rising; computed with the prior session's last 112 regular-hours bars as warm-up, as the desk does) on a bar t_c in [t_s + 1, t_s + 15]
decision time: CONFIRMED: t_c (the add buys the OPEN of t_c + 1). UNCONFIRMED: t_s + 15 (the starter is cut at the OPEN of t_s + 16).
primary measure: FORWARD return from the decision: buy the open after the decision bar, sell the close 30 minutes later (the 'add' trade for confirmed starters; the return the cut avoided for unconfirmed ones), beta-adjusted to SPY over the same bars, minus the same-minute mean of up to 5 other trending names that day (if fewer than 2, other names in the stack_search universe at that minute) - a market/time control

pass (all required).add pays: CONFIRMED forward lift > 0 in both halves (2026-08-03..09-30, 10-01..11-19), day-clustered t >= 2.0, and CONFIRMED mean forward gross minus the real SIP spread at the add > 0
pass (all required).confirmation separates: CONFIRMED minus UNCONFIRMED forward lift > 0 in both halves with day-clustered t >= 2.0
pass (all required).power: MDE = 2.8 x day-clustered SE per half printed before any mean; > 30 bp in either half = UNPROVEN (stated in advance: ~1,486 armed name-days, so only a large effect can show)

reported (information): share of armed name-days with a starter; share of starters confirmed; median minutes to confirmation
the starter's own 30-minute return (all starters, confirmed vs not) - the 'starter holds its own' question
the whole two-stage plan's per-day P&L on a 1/3 starter + 2/3 add sizing, after real spreads
N = 10 and 20 minutes (the 15 is fixed from the measured 14-minute lag)
market open-gap split (<= -1% / flat / >= +1%) and wick-pressure split at the decision bar
checks: unit tests: starter breakout on hand-made bars; square detection identical to opening_square.square_bars with the same warm-up; decision time and entry bars; no bar after the decision is used for the decision
a canary: confirmation assigned at random to starters at the same rate must not pass 'confirmation separates' (20 seeds, <= 10%); a planted +30 bp on CONFIRMED forward returns must pass
counts printed: events, starters, confirmed, unconfirmed, missing prior-session warm-up, fetch failures (> 2% = no verdict)
data: SIP 1-minute bars for each event name on the event day AND the prior session (warm-up), plus the comparison names, fetched after 16:05 ET (shared data key); the multisource_stack inputs are reused where they already hold the bars
fail: anything short of pass. No retuning of the breakout, the square definition, N = 15, the 30-minute forward window or the controls; a change is a new prereg.
if_pass: result-skeptic review; the confirmation step goes into the two-stage shadow lane design with N = 15 and these exact rules
if_fail: record it; the square is not a usable confirmation on armed names - find a different confirmation signal before building the two-stage lane
pre_run_review: result-skeptic reviews this prereg before any code runs (standing checkpoint)
script: tools/studies/square_confirmation.py (to be written after the review)

amended_1.when: 2026-11-20, after result-skeptic round 1 (FIX FIRST: 9 findings), before any script or outcome
amended_1.1 same clock (replaces 'confirmation sep: forward return from the OPEN of t_s+16 to the CLOSE of t_s+45 for BOTH groups (same clock); the add-at-t_c return is reported, not scored; the canary's random labels draw a decision time from the empirical (t_c - t_s) distribution
amended_1.2 already squared: starters with the square already on at t_s form a third group ALREADY_SQUARED (counted and reported); the primary test excludes them
amended_1.3 warm-up: warm-up = the prior session's last 112 RTH bars (a study convention, NOT the desk's line, which uses a 112-minute clock window incl. premarket on IEX/stream data); an IEX-line rerun is required before any shadow lane
amended_1.4 controls: same-name control strictly after: entry in t+hold+2 .. t+hold+62 on the same name-day; each control's mean beside the unconditional random-minute mean, a mismatch (> 2 SE) blocks; same-minute control names must have had their st_new at or before the control minute; the fallback universe uses the same SIP 1-minute RTH bars
amended_1.5 beta: beta to SPY from the prior session's 1-minute bars only
amended_1.6 session end: rows with any scored bar after 15:59 are dropped and counted
amended_1.7 cost and verdicts: net = gross - (half the entry spread + half the exit spread) from SIP quotes; EDGE (the same-clock separation and the add's lift, t >= 2.0 both halves) and PROFITABLE (net > 0 in both halves and at 1.5 x spread) are judged separately
amended_1.8 power gate: before any outcome fetch: per-group counts and a projected MDE from the SD of the pre-event 30-minute return (no outcomes); > 30 bp in either half = UNPROVEN by design and not scored. Stated: edges measured as real on this desk have been 2-5 bp, far below what this sample can detect; a pass would need a large effect.
amended_1.9 canary: random labels with empirical decision times (see #1); planted +30 bp kept

status: amended_1 after skeptic round 1; power gate first; script next
